8mm Metal Momentary Push Button Switch – Waterproof & Self-Resetting

Upgrade your DIY electronics, automotive controls, or home projects with this precision-engineered 8mm Momentary Metal Push Button Switch. Crafted from premium brass with a durable nickel-plated finish, this compact self-reset switch delivers reliable, responsive performance in a wide range of applications — from motorcycle engine starts to doorbells and custom circuit boards.

  • Standard 8mm Mounting Hole: Easy to install with the included locking nut — fits most modification panels and enclosures right out of the box.
  • Wide Application Range: Perfect for motorcycles, balance cars, car engine start buttons, DIY electronic circuits, doorbell systems, and countless other projects.
  • Compact & Lightweight: Weighs just 5–8g per piece — minimal footprint, maximum function.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What does "momentary self-reset" mean for this push button switch?

A: A momentary self-reset switch means that the circuit is only activated while the button is physically pressed. The moment you release your finger, the internal spring mechanism automatically returns the button to its original position, opening the circuit again. This makes it ideal for applications like engine start buttons, doorbells, and short-trigger electronic controls.

Q: Is this 8mm push button switch waterproof, and can it be used outdoors or on motorcycles?

A: Yes — this metal push button switch features a brass nickel-plated housing that is resistant to corrosion and moisture, making it well-suited for outdoor use and automotive/motorcycle applications. The robust alloy construction ensures reliable performance even in environments exposed to the elements.

Q: What panel thickness or mounting setup does this switch require?

A: The switch requires a standard 8mm (0.31 in) mounting hole. It comes with a matching locking nut to secure it firmly to your panel or enclosure. The thread length is 7mm (0.28 in), so it is compatible with most standard panel thicknesses used in DIY electronics, automotive dashboards, and enclosure builds.

description.plain:
600V/10A 22mm Emergency Stop Push Button, Twist to Reset, 1 Contact Normally Closed

Product Name:
Red 600V/10A 22mm Emergency Stop Push Button, Twist to Reset, 1 Contact Normally Closed

Product Overview:
This high-performance Emergency Stop Push Button is designed for industrial control systems, providing a reliable means to immediately cut power and halt operations in emergencies. The push button features a red, visually prominent design, ensuring quick identification in critical situations. It is equipped with a twist-to-reset mechanism, ensuring the button remains in a safe state until the operator intentionally resets it, minimizing accidental restarts.

Key Features:

  • Voltage Rating:
    600V AC/DC, 10A for heavy-duty applications in industrial environments.

  • Size and Mounting:
    22mm diameter for easy panel integration. Compatible with standard 22mm mounting holes, designed for quick installation in control panels or machinery enclosures.

  • Contact Type:
    Single Normally Closed (NC) contact. This configuration ensures that when the button is pressed, the circuit is interrupted, cutting off power immediately for emergency situations.

  • Reset Mechanism:
    Twist-to-reset function. After the button is pressed (emergency stop), the button will remain in a depressed state until manually twisted to reset, preventing accidental restarts and enhancing safety.

  • Material and Durability:
    Constructed with high-quality, durable materials designed to withstand harsh environmental conditions and physical stress. The button is impact-resistant and rated for continuous operation in industrial environments.

  • Indicator Color:
    Bright red actuator for high visibility, ensuring quick identification in emergencies. The color is standardized to alert operators or personnel immediately.

  • IP Rating:
    Typically rated IP65 or equivalent (depending on specific model), offering protection against dust and water ingress. Suitable for use in both indoor and outdoor environments.

  • Operating Temperature Range:
    Typically -25°C to +70°C, making it suitable for a wide range of industrial environments.

  • Safety Compliance:
    Meets international safety standards such as UL, CE, and EN, ensuring reliable performance and operator safety.

Applications:
This emergency stop push button is ideal for use in:

  • Industrial machinery

  • Conveyor systems

  • Control panels and circuit breakers

  • Automated equipment and robotics

  • Heavy-duty electrical systems

Functionality:
When pressed, the Emergency Stop Push Button immediately opens the normally closed contacts, cutting off power or halting operations. The twist-to-reset mechanism ensures the button can only be reset intentionally, reducing the risk of unintended restart and ensuring safety in hazardous environments.

Installation Instructions:

  1. Mount the push button in a 22mm panel cutout.

  2. Secure the button with the provided mounting hardware.

  3. Wire the Normally Closed (NC) terminals according to the system’s emergency stop requirements.

  4. To reset after activation, twist the button clockwise until it clicks into the reset position.

Electrical Ratings:

  • Voltage: 600V AC/DC

  • Current: 10A

  • Contact Configuration: 1 x Normally Closed (NC)
